title: TPC mulls expanding services to Thais
desc: Thailand Privilege Card Co (TPC), the operator of long-term foreign residency programmes, is considering expanding its services to Thai customers to expand its non-visa business over the long term.
title_cn: 泰国特权卡公司考虑向泰籍客户扩展服务
summary_cn: 经营长期外国居民项目的泰国特权卡公司（TPC）正在考虑向泰国本地客户开放服务，以长期拓展其非签证类业务板块。这一举措旨在进一步挖掘国内市场潜力。
desc_original: Thailand Privilege Card Co (TPC), the operator of long-term foreign residency programmes, is considering expanding its services to Thai customers to expand its non-visa business over the long term.

title: Household debt-to-GDP ratio forecast to decline
desc: The Thai household debt-to-GDP ratio is expected to decline to 84% by the end of this year, regardless of GDP growth, according to a study by the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce (UTCC).
title_cn: 泰国家庭债务与 GDP 比率预计继续下降
summary_cn: 泰国工商总会大学（UTCC）研究预测，泰国家庭债务与 GDP 比率将在今年底降至 84%，这一下降趋势不因 GDP 增速波动而改变。数据显示泰国家庭债务负担正逐步改善。
desc_original: The Thai household debt-to-GDP ratio is expected to decline to 84% by the end of this year, regardless of GDP growth, according to a study by the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce (UTCC).

title: PM issues deadline for exam inquiry
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Interior Ministry to conclude its investigation into alleged cheating in local government recruitment examinations by Sept 30.
title_cn: 总理下令 9 月 30 日前完成地方招考舞弊调查
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷 Anutin 要求内政部在 9 月 30 日前完成对地方政府招聘考试作弊指控的调查。该调查涉及地方招考中的舞弊行为，是政府打击腐败、维护招考公正的重要行动。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Interior Ministry to conclude its investigation into alleged cheating in local government recruitment examinations by Sept 30.

title: Taiwan's ALP to build B10bn smart warehouse in Thailand
desc: Taiwan-based smart warehouse and logistics provider Ally Logistic Property (ALP) is investing 10 billion baht to build the "Omega 1 Bangna" smart warehouse in Thailand, its largest facility in Asia.
title_cn: 台湾 ALP 投资 100 亿泰铢在泰建设「Omega 1 邦纳」智能仓库
summary_cn: 台湾智能仓储物流商 ALP（联盟仓储地产）投资 100 亿泰铢在泰国建设「Omega 1 邦纳」智能仓库，这是该公司在亚洲规模最大的设施。
desc_original: Taiwan-based smart warehouse and logistics provider Ally Logistic Property (ALP) is investing 10 billion baht to build the "Omega 1 Bangna" smart warehouse in Thailand, its largest facility in Asia.

title: Tie-up to protect pensioners from scams
desc: The Government Pension Fund (GPF) has teamed up with technology companies to help protect elderly people from tech-enabled fraud.
title_cn: 政府养老基金携手科技企业守护老年人防范诈骗
summary_cn: 泰国政府养老基金与科技公司联手开展合作，推出保护措施帮助老年人防范科技诈骗威胁。
desc_original: The Government Pension Fund (GPF) has teamed up with technology companies to help protect elderly people from tech-enabled fraud.

title: PM distances govt  from Vorapak saga
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has distanced his government from allegations linking former deputy finance minister Vorapak Tanyawong to Southeast Asian scam networks, saying Mr Vorapak must clear his name himself.
title_cn: 总理与沃拉帕克诈骗案保持距离
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷表示政府与前副财政部长沃拉帕克涉嫌东南亚诈骗网络的指控无关，认为沃拉帕克必须自行澄清名誉。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has distanced his government from allegations linking former deputy finance minister Vorapak Tanyawong to Southeast Asian scam networks, saying Mr Vorapak must clear his name himself.

title: Fed rate hike puts spotlight on 2027 view
desc: The Federal Reserve's interest rate hike has shifted market attention to the 2027 outlook, with persistently high borrowing costs and US bond yields pressuring Thai stocks, though a less hawkish longer-term assessment could ease concerns for emerging markets, note analysts.
title_cn: 美联储加息引发 2027 年前景关注
summary_cn: 美联储加息将市场焦点转向 2027 年前景。持续高企的借贷成本和美国债券收益率对泰国股市构成压力，但分析师认为较不鹰派的长期展望可缓解新兴市场忧虑。
desc_original: The Federal Reserve's interest rate hike has shifted market attention to the 2027 outlook, with persistently high borrowing costs and US bond yields pressuring Thai stocks, though a less hawkish longer-term assessment could ease concerns for emerging markets, note analysts.

title: Central invests $3bn in Vietnam to fuel growth

summary_cn: 泰国中央集团在越南追加投资 30 亿美元（约 1000 亿泰铢），用于扩大零售运营和房产开发项目。
desc_original: Central Group is investing another US$3 billion (100 billion baht) in Vietnam to expand its retail operations and property development projects.

title: New financial literacy programme focuses on Thai youth
desc: PrimeStreet Group, a Bangkok-based investment banking and management firm, has teamed up with Chulalongkorn University to launch a new financial literacy initiative aimed at strengthening the money management skills of Thailand's younger generation.
title_cn: 新金融素养计划聚焦泰国青年
summary_cn: PrimeStreet Group 曼谷投资银行公司携手朱拉隆功大学 Chulalongkorn University 推出金融素养倡议，旨在加强泰国年轻一代的理财管理能力，涵盖投资、储蓄、风险管理等实用知识教学。
desc_original: PrimeStreet Group, a Bangkok-based investment banking and management firm, has teamed up with Chulalongkorn University to launch a new financial literacy initiative aimed at strengthening the money management skills of Thailand's younger generation.

title: Maritime talks start on 'positive' note: govt
desc: The first meeting in a compulsory conciliation process between Thailand and Cambodia over their maritime dispute was positive overall, with the process expected to take 11-12 months, according to a senior Foreign Ministry official.
title_cn: 泰柬海事谈判开局「积极」——政府宣称
summary_cn: 泰国与柬埔寨就海上争议进行首轮强制调解，外交部高官表示进展「积极」，预计整个调解过程需时11-12个月。这一争议涉及两国领土边界划分与海洋权益，是长期悬而未决的外交难题。
desc_original: The first meeting in a compulsory conciliation process between Thailand and Cambodia over their maritime dispute was positive overall, with the process expected to take 11-12 months, according to a senior Foreign Ministry official.

title: Queen Mother's cremation plans advance
desc: The government is preparing for the royal cremation ceremony for Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother scheduled for mid-December.
title_cn: 王太后火化仪式筹备工作推进
summary_cn: 泰国政府正为王太后诗丽吉陛下 Queen Sirikit 的皇家火化仪式做筹备工作，仪式定于12月中旬举行。该庆典规模宏大，将涉及广泛人员聚集、交通管制与公共活动安排。
desc_original: The government is preparing for the royal cremation ceremony for Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother scheduled for mid-December.

title: THAI launches Da Nang route

title_cn: 泰航开通岘港新航线
summary_cn: 泰国国际航空公司 Thai Airways International (THAI) 宣布扩展航网，新增曼谷至越南岘港 Da Nang 的直航服务，并增加东南亚、欧洲及中国等多条国际航线班次。此举便利区域商务与旅游往来。
desc_original: Thai Airways International (THAI) will expand its network with a new Bangkok-Da Nang service and more flights on routes across Southeast Asia, Europe and China.

title: Travel plan exposes 'double life'
desc: A visa application to visit China has exposed the identity of a Chinese murder suspect who had lived and conducted business in Pattaya for decades.
title_cn: 赴华签证申请揭露通缉逃犯「双重身份」
summary_cn: 一名中国通缉逃犯的赴华签证申请曝光了其真实身份。此人在芭提雅 Pattaya 长期居住经商，涉嫌多年前谋杀案。案件引发跨国刑事合作，提醒在泰外国人及当地商人警惕隐藏身份的逃犯。
desc_original: A visa application to visit China has exposed the identity of a Chinese murder suspect who had lived and conducted business in Pattaya for decades.

title: CPN bags award for festive campaign

desc_original: Central Pattana Plc (CPN) received an award in the community category at the 2026 ICSC Global Maxi Awards for its "The World's Great Celebration – Local Pride Christmas Trees" campaign.

title: Monetary policy ‘very accommodative’; growth outlook unchanged: central bank
desc: The Bank of Thailand's (BoT) monetary policy is "very, very accommodative" right now to support a weak economy, with growth expected to exceed 3% in the current quarter and hit around 2% in the last quarter of 2026, an assistant governor said on Thursday.
title_cn: 泰央行维持宽松货币政策 第三季度增速预期超3%
summary_cn: 泰国央行副行长表示，央行目前维持「非常宽松」的货币政策以支撑疲弱经济。预期当季经济增速将超过3%，四季度增速约2%。货币政策放宽旨在刺激经济增长，应对当前经济压力，将直接影响物价和汇率。
desc_original: The Bank of Thailand's (BoT) monetary policy is "very, very accommodative" right now to support a weak economy, with growth expected to exceed 3% in the current quarter and hit around 2% in the last quarter of 2026, an assistant governor said on Thursday.

title: Yaya、Gulf、Kao首次同台飙戏 《谎日》10月6日上线
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月17日，据泰媒报道，备受期待的泰剧《谎日》（Beneath the Lies）即将与观众见面。这部由泰国第3电视台推出的剧集由Yaya Urassaya、Gulf Kanawut和Kao Noppakao联袂出演，并于9月16日发布了预告片。 《谎日》是一部爱情剧情类电视剧，讲述错综复杂的情感关系，以及伴随其中的谎言，同时贯穿代际延续的仇恨，这使三个年轻人的感情面临重重考验，并进一步探讨“爱情应该属于两个人，而不是三个人”这一主题。 该剧由Maker K制作，最早于2025年11月举行的“Ch3有什么新作品”阵容发布会上首次公布，除了剧情充满张力之外，其卡司阵容也在社交媒体上引发了广泛关注，其中，两位男演员此前曾凭借电视剧《名门绅士2：淑女之心》及系列作品为观众所熟悉，三人将在本剧中展现全新的化学反应。 《谎日》将于10月6日起每周一、周二20时30分通过泰国第3电视台播出。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：TheStandardPOP） The post Yaya、Gulf、Kao首次同台飙戏 《谎日》10月6日上线 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Carabao brushes off jibe over 1m baht Nene Royal support
desc: Carabao brushes off jibe over 1m baht Nene Royal support Legacy Thai rock veteran Add Carabao has brushed off online criticism accusing him of riding Nene Royal’s popularity after pledging 1 million baht to help the teenage Phuket guitarist travel to the United States for the America’s Got Talent final . The Carabao frontman addressed the backlash at the Concert for Guitarking Lam Morrison 2026 at Tawandang German Brewery yesterday, September 16. He admitted that one online remark accusing him of using Nene’s fame and suggesting he was too old to be doing so had irritated him enough to swear on stage earlier in the evening. Asked later whether the comment still bothered him, Add dismissed it. “Forget it. It’s passed. Enough about that.” Nene Royal, whose full name is Rattikarn “Praew” Amloy, is a 16 year old singer and guitarist from Phuket. She secured a place in the America’s Got Talent Season 21 final after judge Mel B awarded her the Live Golden Buzzer for her performance of Soundgarden’s Black Hole Sun . title: Thai Airways expands winter schedule with 66 global routes
desc: Thai Airways expands winter schedule with 66 global routes Legacy Thai Airways will operate 66 routes worldwide during its 2026/27 winter schedule, adding a new Bangkok-Danang service and increasing frequencies on selected regional routes. The winter timetable will run from October 25, 2026, to March 27, 2027, Thai Airways executives said today, September 17. The airline will launch its new Bangkok-Danang route on December 1, with 14 return flights per week. Thai Airways will also increase Bangkok-Vientiane and Bangkok-Yangon services to 21 flights per week, while Bangkok-Siem Reap will operate seven times weekly. In Europe, the airline will operate seven weekly flights to Amsterdam, 10 to Munich, 11 to Zurich and 14 to Paris. The Bangkok-Xiamen route will also return with four flights per week. Photo via Bornil Amin on Unsplash Thai Airways said it has adjusted its business strategy to remain flexible amid global uncertainty while maintaining financial stability. The company reported a net profit of 1.537 billion baht in the second quarter. title: 夺金200万泰铢，赛后7天内发放！泰国公布亚运会奖金标准
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国国家体育局局长贡萨近日表示，泰国已为参加第20届亚洲运动会“爱知·名古屋2026”的国家队运动员做好各项保障及奖金准备。比赛结束后，国家体育局将按照国家体育发展基金相关标准，在7天内举行奖金颁发活动。 第20届亚洲运动会将于9月19日至10月4日在日本爱知县名古屋举行。目前，部分泰国运动员已提前抵达日本参加比赛及训练，其余运动员则继续在国内训练，并将按照赛程陆续出发。 贡萨表示，此前国家体育局已为运动员提供全面保障，包括训练津贴、体育科学、营养以及心理方面的支持，确保运动员以最佳状态参赛。在经费方面，目前不存在任何问题，包括比赛奖金在内，国家体育局已与国家体育发展基金完成相关准备。 他鼓励泰国运动员在比赛中全力以赴，无需担心后勤及奖金问题。比赛结束后，相关奖金将按照国家体育发展基金的规定，在7天内完成发放。 根据国家体育发展基金针对亚运会制定的奖金标准，泰国运动员获得金牌可获得200万泰铢，银牌100万泰铢，铜牌50万泰铢。 教练员奖金则根据运动员人数及项目类型计算。其中，个人项目或运动员人数不超过6人的团队项目，教练员可获得运动员奖金的20%，即金牌40万泰铢、银牌20万泰铢、铜牌10万泰铢。 对于运动员人数达到7人及以上的团队项目，教练员可获得运动员奖金的10%，即金牌20万泰铢、银牌10万泰铢、铜牌5万泰铢。 此外，代表相关运动项目的泰国体育协会，可获得运动员所获奖金总额的30%，但最高金额不超过1000万泰铢。 （编译：Wan；来源：dailynews） The post 夺金200万泰铢，赛后7天内发放！泰国公布亚运会奖金标准 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 曼谷拉玛三路输油管道渗漏！VOC超标，专家警告仍有着火风险
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国能源部、污染控制厅及输油管道公司代表日前前往曼谷拉玛三路高架桥下方的Chuea Phloeng路一带，对输油管道油料渗漏情况展开现场检查，并加紧寻找确切泄漏点，以便进行维修，同时检查管道系统的安全状况。 泰国能源部长秘书蒂提帕表示，目前输油管道公司工程师、技术人员及相关私营石油企业工作人员，正在将设备运至现场，准备移开此前在疑似渗漏区域安装的“Sleeve”（管道外套/保护套），以检查内部输油管道是否存在裂缝，以及具体受损位置。 预计今晚将能够确认明确的泄漏点。如果发现管道破损，工作人员将立即进行维修，并开展管道清管检测，对整条输油管线进行全面检查。这条管线全长约32公里，从私人油库一直延伸至机场油库，旨在进一步排查其他可能存在的风险点或异常情况。 至于此次油料渗漏的具体原因，目前仍在调查中。初步认为可能涉及多种因素，包括管道锈蚀，以及车辆长期通行产生的撞击或震动等。 如果检查确认管道已经受损，相关方面将考虑更换新管道，并研究调整管道铺设路线。由于目前管道位置靠近桥墩，且每天24小时都有车辆通行，长期震动可能导致管道再次受损。 与此同时，泰国能源业务厅已要求该输油管道公司提供管道维护和保养记录，以调查是否存在维护不足的情况，同时检查现有管道铺设路线是否依法取得许可。如果发现违规或异常情况，将依法处理。不过，目前初步检查显示，该管道仍属于获得批准的输油管道系统。 蒂提帕进一步透露，此前工作人员发现桥墩下方存在油迹后，曾开挖地面，对约200米范围进行检查并开展测试，但当时尚未发现明确的泄漏点。因此，工作人员分段封堵排水管道，以防止油料进一步造成污染。 随后，曼谷排水部门对相关管道进行清理时，发现土壤中存在油料污染，于是进一步扩大检查范围，对桥墩附近区域进行排查，并发现了新的油料渗漏点。工作人员随后再次进行检测并发现异常，最终进一步对该区域的输油管道展开详细检查。 另一方面，泰国污染控制厅环境学专家苏梅公布了现场污染监测结果。 他表示，自事故发生以来，工作人员一直持续监测现场的VOC（挥发性有机化合物）浓度，以及用于评估着火风险的LEL（爆炸下限）指标。 初步监测发现，现场VOC浓度较高，数值超过300，已经达到可能对人体健康造成影响的水平。同时，LEL指标显示现场仍存在着火风险。 不过，在工作人员将泄漏的油料重新抽回管道系统后，VOC和LEL数值均呈现下降趋势。 尽管如此，工作人员仍需要持续进行监测。目前作业区域仍必须严格采取火花控制措施，因为现场依然存在着火风险。 苏梅表示，相较于泄漏发生的核心区域，周边居民受到的影响可能相对较小。 目前，相关公司已经在作业区域安装化学蒸气抽吸设备，用于过滤现场VOC。通过从污染源头直接控制和处理挥发性物质，可以减少这些物质向周边区域扩散。 （编译：Wan；来源：pptvhd36） The post 曼谷

title: Phuket inquiry ordered into alleged checkpoint extortion
desc: Phuket inquiry ordered into alleged checkpoint extortion Legacy A Phuket extortion probe has been ordered into allegations that officials at a late-night drug checkpoint in Thalang demanded cash from detainees in exchange for their release. Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit instructed the Department of Provincial Administration (DOPA) and Phuket officials to urgently establish what happened, identify those involved and examine evidence relating to the allegations. title: Half of Thais carry debt from age 30 into retirement, expert says
desc: Half of Thais carry debt from age 30 into retirement, expert says Legacy Thai household debt could climb to 16.5–16.6 trillion baht by the end of 2026, with around half of Thais taking on debt from the age of 30 and many continuing to carry it into retirement . Associate Professor Dr Thanavath Phonvichai, president of the University of the Thai Chamber of Commerce (UTCC), said today, September 17, that household debt had become a structural problem requiring urgent attention. Bank of Thailand data cited by Thanavath showed that around half of Thais begin carrying debt by the age of 30. By the age of 70, average outstanding debt remains close to 300,000 baht. Only a small proportion of people are also able to save according to plan for retirement, he said. Photo via UTCC Today Financial pressure has been particularly severe this year among households earning less than 30,000 baht per month. Many are living from month to month, with income failing to cover living costs and forcing families to borrow more for everyday expenses or to keep household finances afloat. Borrowing through formal channels has increasingly been used to support household cash flow, particularly through savings

title: Kao launches school hygiene programme with CONNEXT ED in Chonburi
desc: Kao launches school hygiene programme with CONNEXT ED in Chonburi Legacy Kao Industrial (Thailand) Co., Ltd., a Japanese manufacturer of consumer products and chemicals, has launched the Kao Care & Protect School Program , its first initiative dedicated to supporting healthier school environments. Developed in partnership with the CONNEXT ED Foundation, the programme supports hygiene and environmental education while helping schools create clean and safe surroundings where children can learn and grow. The initiative forms part of Kao’s ESG strategy, the Kirei Lifestyle Plan. In its first year, the programme is being piloted at three schools near Kao’s manufacturing plant in Chonburi province: Phutthayakhom Kindergarten School (Wat Khao Bang Sai), Choomchon Wat Nong Tamlung, and Chonkanyanukoon School. Activities are tailored to the needs and circumstances of each school, allowing hygiene education to move beyond the classroom and become part of students’ daily routines. Over time, the programme aims to help good hygiene take root as a lasting culture within each school. title: Thailand maps 11 expressway projects worth nearly 300bn baht
desc: Thailand maps 11 expressway projects worth nearly 300bn baht Legacy The Expressway Authority of Thailand (EXAT) is advancing 11 expressway projects worth more than 296.6 billion baht across Bangkok, surrounding provinces and major tourist destinations including Phuket , Koh Samui and Koh Chang. Some routes are already under construction, while others remain at approval or feasibility-study stages, with several new projects expected to begin construction from 2027. EXAT Governor Surachet Laophulsuk said the authority is drawing up a new enterprise plan as travel patterns continue to differ from before the Covid-19 pandemic. Average traffic on the expressway network is around 1.7 million vehicles per day, below the previous level of about 1.9 million, while annual profit is currently around 8 to 10 billion baht. Two of the 11 projects are already under construction.
